projectSettingsConversions.intro: Conversions are defined once for this project. Each connected analytics source keeps its own daily counts, and the primary source is the default view.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Choose the primary source for the default view. Changing it keeps every source's data and adds a chart note.
sources.ga4Together: GA4 reports all key events together.
sources.plausibleOrganic: Organic search goal conversions, one daily count per landing page.
sources.syncError: The source could not be synced.
sources.confirmBody: Charts will use {source} as the default view. Existing data stays, and a note is added so a jump has a reason.
sources.error: The primary source could not be saved.

comparison.title: All sources side by side
comparison.description: Enabled conversions in the last 28 days, one column per connected source.
comparison.empty: No enabled conversions in the last 28 days.

goals.title: Conversions
goals.description: Rename a conversion for this project, or stop it from counting. The name in the tool stays as the source reports it.
goals.emptyDescription: When a connected source reports a conversion, it shows up here.
goals.error: The conversion could not be saved.
